parameters.query: SELECT topic_title FROM videos ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-4.1-mini', input: [{ role: 'system', content: `You are a senior YouTube content strategist. Channel niche: ${$json.channel_niche}. Return valid JSON only.` }, { role: 'user', content: `${$json.channel_url ? 'Analyze this YouTube channel: ' + $json.channel_url + '

' : ''}Create ONE high-retention video topic package for a ${$json.channel_niche} YouTube channel.
Do NOT reuse these topics: [${$json.previous_topics}].
Output JSON: title, core_emotion, audience_promise, thumbnail_text, seo_keywords (array), hook_angle, story_seed, why_this_works.` }], text: { format: { type: 'json_object' } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-4.1-mini', input: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a YouTube retention editor. Return valid JSON only.' }, { role: 'user', content: `QA check this script. Score 0-100 for: retention, emotional clarity, topic accuracy, YouTube suitability.
Return JSON: score_0_100, verdict (pass/fail), issues (array), suggested_fixes (array).

Script:
${$json.script.narration_script}` }], text: { format: { type: 'json_object' } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL || 'gpt-image-2', prompt: `YouTube thumbnail for: ${$json.title}. Text overlay area: ${$json.thumbnail_text}. Style: ${$json.seo_keywords?.join(', ')}. Cinematic, emotional, high contrast, no watermark, no logo.`, size: '1792x1024' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'accepted', episode_id: $('Code - Merge Config').first().json.episode_id, scenes: $('Code - Build Manifest').first().json.scenes?.length, worker_response: $input.first().json }) }}

meta.description: Generic full-auto YouTube pipeline: channel analysis → topic → GPT script → Claude refinement → QA → scene breakdown → DALL-E images → Python worker. Works for any niche.
